package domain

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

const (
	GeneratedCourseOriginLearningPlanner = "learning_planner"
	MaximumGeneratedCoursePayloadBytes   = 16 << 20
)

type CourseTargetRef struct {
	Type    LearningTargetType `json:"type"`
	Key     string             `json:"key"`
	Version string             `json:"version"`
}

type CourseTransitionKnowledge struct {
	SourceStack     string          `json:"source_stack"`
	Target          CourseTargetRef `json:"target"`
	Similarity      string          `json:"similarity"`
	Difference      string          `json:"difference"`
	AnalogyBoundary string          `json:"analogy_boundary"`
	CommonMistakes  []string        `json:"common_mistakes"`
}

type CoursePedagogyStrategyRef struct {
	Code    string `json:"code"`
	Version int    `json:"version"`
}

type GeneratedCourseLesson struct {
	Code                string                      `json:"code"`
	Title               string                      `json:"title"`
	Excerpt             string                      `json:"excerpt"`
	Order               int                         `json:"order"`
	Status              string                      `json:"status"`
	Targets             []CourseTargetRef           `json:"targets"`
	Prerequisites       []CourseTargetRef           `json:"prerequisites"`
	TransitionKnowledge []CourseTransitionKnowledge `json:"transition_knowledge,omitempty"`
	PedagogyStrategies  []CoursePedagogyStrategyRef `json:"pedagogy_strategies"`
	DescriptionMarkdown string                      `json:"description_markdown"`
	Examples            []GeneratedCourseExample    `json:"examples"`
	Tasks               []GeneratedCourseTask       `json:"tasks"`
}

type GeneratedCourseExample struct {
	Title               string   `json:"title"`
	DescriptionMarkdown string   `json:"description_markdown"`
	PrimaryStack        string   `json:"primary_stack,omitempty"`
	Stacks              []string `json:"stacks"`
	TargetConcepts      []string `json:"target_concepts"`
}

type GeneratedCourseTask struct {
	Title               string   `json:"title"`
	DescriptionMarkdown string   `json:"description_markdown"`
	ExpectedAnswers     []string `json:"expected_answers"`
}

type GeneratedCourseSection struct {
	Code    string                  `json:"code"`
	Title   string                  `json:"title"`
	Order   int                     `json:"order"`
	Lessons []GeneratedCourseLesson `json:"lessons"`
}

type GeneratedCourseModule struct {
	Code     string                   `json:"code"`
	Title    string                   `json:"title"`
	Order    int                      `json:"order"`
	Sections []GeneratedCourseSection `json:"sections"`
}

type GeneratedCourse struct {
	Fingerprint        string                  `json:"course_fingerprint"`
	FingerprintVersion string                  `json:"fingerprint_version"`
	GoalCode           string                  `json:"goal_code"`
	GoalVersion        string                  `json:"goal_version"`
	Title              string                  `json:"title"`
	Description        string                  `json:"description"`
	Language           string                  `json:"language"`
	Status             string                  `json:"status"`
	CatalogVisible     bool                    `json:"catalog_visible"`
	PlannerVersion     string                  `json:"planner_version"`
	PedagogyProfile    string                  `json:"pedagogy_profile"`
	PresentationStyle  string                  `json:"presentation_style"`
	GenerationPolicy   string                  `json:"generation_policy"`
	Modules            []GeneratedCourseModule `json:"modules"`
}

type GeneratedCourseRecord struct {
	CourseID           string
	Origin             string
	Fingerprint        string
	FingerprintVersion string
	GoalCode           string
	GoalVersion        string
	Language           string
	PlannerVersion     string
	PedagogyProfile    string
	PresentationStyle  string
	GenerationPolicy   string
	PlanJSON           []byte
}

type GeneratedLessonRecord struct {
	LessonID                string
	CourseID                string
	ModuleCode              string
	SectionCode             string
	LessonCode              string
	TargetsJSON             []byte
	PrerequisitesJSON       []byte
	TransitionKnowledgeJSON []byte
	PedagogyStrategiesJSON  []byte
}

type GeneratedCourseRequest struct {
	IdempotencyKey string
	RequestHash    string
	CourseID       string
	Reused         bool
}

type EnsureGeneratedCourseResult struct {
	CourseID string                   `json:"course_id"`
	Reused   bool                     `json:"reused"`
	Lessons  []GeneratedLessonBinding `json:"lessons"`
}

type GeneratedLessonBinding struct {
	LessonRevisionID string            `json:"lesson_revision_id,omitempty"`
	LessonID         string            `json:"lesson_id"`
	Order            int               `json:"order"`
	Targets          []CourseTargetRef `json:"targets"`
}

func NormalizeGeneratedCourse(input GeneratedCourse) (GeneratedCourse, error) {
	input.Fingerprint = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.Fingerprint))
	input.FingerprintVersion = normalizeGeneratedShortCode(input.FingerprintVersion)
	input.GoalCode = normalizeGeneratedShortCode(input.GoalCode)
	input.GoalVersion = normalizeGeneratedShortCode(input.GoalVersion)
	input.Title = strings.TrimSpace(input.Title)
	input.Description = strings.TrimSpace(input.Description)
	input.Language = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.Language))
	input.Status = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(input.Status))
	input.PlannerVersion = normalizeGeneratedShortCode(input.PlannerVersion)
	input.PedagogyProfile = normalizeGeneratedShortCode(input.PedagogyProfile)
	input.PresentationStyle = normalizeGeneratedShortCode(input.PresentationStyle)
	input.GenerationPolicy = normalizeGeneratedShortCode(input.GenerationPolicy)
	if !validSHA256(input.Fingerprint) || input.FingerprintVersion == "" || input.GoalCode == "" ||
		input.GoalVersion == "" || input.Title == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(input.Title) > 255 ||
		!utf8.ValidString(input.Description) || len(input.Description) > 64<<10 ||
		!validGeneratedLanguage(input.Language) || input.Status != "ACTIVE" || input.CatalogVisible ||
		input.PlannerVersion == "" || input.PedagogyProfile == "" || input.PresentationStyle == "" ||
		input.GenerationPolicy == "" || len(input.Modules) == 0 || len(input.Modules) > 100 {
		return GeneratedCourse{}, ErrValidation
	}
	moduleCodes := make(map[string]struct{}, len(input.Modules))
	moduleOrders := make(map[int]struct{}, len(input.Modules))
	lessonCount := 0
	for moduleIndex := range input.Modules {
		module := &input.Modules[moduleIndex]
		module.Code = normalizeGeneratedShortCode(module.Code)
		module.Title = strings.TrimSpace(module.Title)
		if module.Code == "" || module.Title == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(module.Title) > 255 || module.Order < 0 ||
			module.Order > 32767 || len(module.Sections) == 0 || len(module.Sections) > 100 {
			return GeneratedCourse{}, ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := moduleCodes[module.Code]; duplicate {
			return GeneratedCourse{}, ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := moduleOrders[module.Order]; duplicate {
			return GeneratedCourse{}, ErrValidation
		}
		moduleCodes[module.Code] = struct{}{}
		moduleOrders[module.Order] = struct{}{}
		if err := normalizeGeneratedSections(module.Sections, &lessonCount); err != nil {
			return GeneratedCourse{}, err
		}
		sort.Slice(module.Sections, func(left, right int) bool {
			return module.Sections[left].Order < module.Sections[right].Order
		})
	}
	if lessonCount == 0 || lessonCount > 500 {
		return GeneratedCourse{}, ErrValidation
	}
	sort.Slice(input.Modules, func(left, right int) bool { return input.Modules[left].Order < input.Modules[right].Order })
	return input, nil
}

func normalizeGeneratedSections(sections []GeneratedCourseSection, lessonCount *int) error {
	codes := make(map[string]struct{}, len(sections))
	orders := make(map[int]struct{}, len(sections))
	for sectionIndex := range sections {
		section := &sections[sectionIndex]
		section.Code = normalizeGeneratedShortCode(section.Code)
		section.Title = strings.TrimSpace(section.Title)
		if section.Code == "" || section.Title == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(section.Title) > 255 || section.Order < 0 ||
			section.Order > 32767 || len(section.Lessons) == 0 || len(section.Lessons) > 200 {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := codes[section.Code]; duplicate {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := orders[section.Order]; duplicate {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		codes[section.Code] = struct{}{}
		orders[section.Order] = struct{}{}
		*lessonCount += len(section.Lessons)
		if err := normalizeGeneratedLessons(section.Lessons); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		sort.Slice(section.Lessons, func(left, right int) bool {
			return section.Lessons[left].Order < section.Lessons[right].Order
		})
	}
	return nil
}

func normalizeGeneratedLessons(lessons []GeneratedCourseLesson) error {
	codes := make(map[string]struct{}, len(lessons))
	orders := make(map[int]struct{}, len(lessons))
	for lessonIndex := range lessons {
		lesson := &lessons[lessonIndex]
		lesson.Code = normalizeGeneratedShortCode(lesson.Code)
		lesson.Title = strings.TrimSpace(lesson.Title)
		lesson.Excerpt = strings.TrimSpace(lesson.Excerpt)
		lesson.Status = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(lesson.Status))
		if lesson.Code == "" || lesson.Title == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(lesson.Title) > 255 ||
			!utf8.ValidString(lesson.Excerpt) || len(lesson.Excerpt) > 16<<10 || lesson.Order < 0 ||
			lesson.Order > 32767 || lesson.Status != "ACTIVE" || len(lesson.Targets) == 0 ||
			len(lesson.Targets) > 100 || len(lesson.Prerequisites) > 100 ||
			len(lesson.TransitionKnowledge) > 100 || len(lesson.PedagogyStrategies) == 0 ||
			len(lesson.PedagogyStrategies) > 50 {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := codes[lesson.Code]; duplicate {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := orders[lesson.Order]; duplicate {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		codes[lesson.Code] = struct{}{}
		orders[lesson.Order] = struct{}{}
		var err error
		lesson.Targets, err = normalizeCourseTargets(lesson.Targets)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		lesson.Prerequisites, err = normalizeCourseTargets(lesson.Prerequisites)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := normalizeTransitionKnowledge(lesson.TransitionKnowledge, lesson.Targets); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := normalizePedagogyStrategies(lesson.PedagogyStrategies); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := normalizeGeneratedLessonArtifacts(lesson); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func normalizeGeneratedLessonArtifacts(lesson *GeneratedCourseLesson) error {
	lesson.DescriptionMarkdown = strings.TrimSpace(lesson.DescriptionMarkdown)
	if lesson.DescriptionMarkdown == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(lesson.DescriptionMarkdown) > 64000 ||
		len(lesson.Examples) == 0 || len(lesson.Examples) > 12 || len(lesson.Tasks) == 0 || len(lesson.Tasks) > 12 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	for index := range lesson.Examples {
		example := &lesson.Examples[index]
		example.Title = strings.TrimSpace(example.Title)
		example.DescriptionMarkdown = strings.TrimSpace(example.DescriptionMarkdown)
		example.PrimaryStack = normalizeGeneratedShortCode(example.PrimaryStack)
		example.Stacks = normalizeGeneratedStringList(example.Stacks)
		example.TargetConcepts = normalizeGeneratedStringList(example.TargetConcepts)
		if example.Title == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(example.Title) > 255 || example.DescriptionMarkdown == "" ||
			utf8.RuneCountInString(example.DescriptionMarkdown) > 32000 || len(example.Stacks) == 0 ||
			len(example.TargetConcepts) == 0 {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	}
	for index := range lesson.Tasks {
		task := &lesson.Tasks[index]
		task.Title = strings.TrimSpace(task.Title)
		task.DescriptionMarkdown = strings.TrimSpace(task.DescriptionMarkdown)
		task.ExpectedAnswers = normalizeGeneratedStringList(task.ExpectedAnswers)
		if task.Title == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(task.Title) > 255 || task.DescriptionMarkdown == "" ||
			utf8.RuneCountInString(task.DescriptionMarkdown) > 16000 || len(task.ExpectedAnswers) == 0 ||
			len(task.ExpectedAnswers) > 20 {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func normalizeGeneratedStringList(input []string) []string {
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(input))
	result := make([]string, 0, len(input))
	for _, value := range input {
		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
		if value == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(value) > 2000 {
			return nil
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[value]; duplicate {
			continue
		}
		seen[value] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, value)
	}
	return result
}

func normalizeCourseTargets(targets []CourseTargetRef) ([]CourseTargetRef, error) {
	result := make([]CourseTargetRef, len(targets))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
	for index, target := range targets {
		target.Key = normalizeGeneratedCode(target.Key)
		target.Version = normalizeGeneratedShortCode(target.Version)
		identity := courseTargetIdentity(target)
		if (target.Type != LearningTargetConcept && target.Type != LearningTargetCapability) ||
			target.Key == "" || target.Version == "" {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[identity]; duplicate {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		seen[identity] = struct{}{}
		result[index] = target
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(left, right int) bool {
		return courseTargetIdentity(result[left]) < courseTargetIdentity(result[right])
	})
	return result, nil
}

func normalizeTransitionKnowledge(items []CourseTransitionKnowledge, targets []CourseTargetRef) error {
	allowed := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
	for _, target := range targets {
		allowed[courseTargetIdentity(target)] = struct{}{}
	}
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
	for index := range items {
		item := &items[index]
		item.SourceStack = normalizeGeneratedShortCode(item.SourceStack)
		normalized, err := normalizeCourseTargets([]CourseTargetRef{item.Target})
		if err != nil || item.SourceStack == "" {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		item.Target = normalized[0]
		item.Similarity = strings.TrimSpace(item.Similarity)
		item.Difference = strings.TrimSpace(item.Difference)
		item.AnalogyBoundary = strings.TrimSpace(item.AnalogyBoundary)
		identity := item.SourceStack + "\x00" + courseTargetIdentity(item.Target)
		if _, exists := allowed[courseTargetIdentity(item.Target)]; !exists || item.Similarity == "" ||
			item.Difference == "" || item.AnalogyBoundary == "" || len(item.CommonMistakes) > 50 {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[identity]; duplicate {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		seen[identity] = struct{}{}
		for mistakeIndex, mistake := range item.CommonMistakes {
			item.CommonMistakes[mistakeIndex] = strings.TrimSpace(mistake)
			if item.CommonMistakes[mistakeIndex] == "" || len(item.CommonMistakes[mistakeIndex]) > 2000 {
				return ErrValidation
			}
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(items, func(left, right int) bool {
		leftID := items[left].SourceStack + "\x00" + courseTargetIdentity(items[left].Target)
		rightID := items[right].SourceStack + "\x00" + courseTargetIdentity(items[right].Target)
		return leftID < rightID
	})
	return nil
}

func normalizePedagogyStrategies(items []CoursePedagogyStrategyRef) error {
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
	for index := range items {
		items[index].Code = normalizeGeneratedShortCode(items[index].Code)
		identity := items[index].Code + ":" + strconv.Itoa(items[index].Version)
		if items[index].Code == "" || items[index].Version < 1 {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[identity]; duplicate {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		seen[identity] = struct{}{}
	}
	return nil
}

func normalizeGeneratedCode(value string) string {
	normalized, err := NormalizeContentSourceKey(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value)))
	if err != nil || len(normalized) > 255 {
		return ""
	}
	return normalized
}

func normalizeGeneratedShortCode(value string) string {
	normalized := normalizeGeneratedCode(value)
	if len(normalized) > 64 {
		return ""
	}
	return normalized
}

func courseTargetIdentity(target CourseTargetRef) string {
	return string(target.Type) + "\x00" + target.Key + "\x00" + target.Version
}

func validSHA256(value string) bool {
	decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
	return err == nil && len(decoded) == 32 && value == strings.ToLower(value)
}

func validGeneratedLanguage(value string) bool {
	if len(value) < 2 || len(value) > 16 {
		return false
	}
	for _, current := range value {
		if (current < 'a' || current > 'z') && current != '-' {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
